description: This file defines the interface DigitalProductDao, which extends a generic DAO interface to handle DigitalProduct entities and includes a method to retrieve a DigitalProduct by product and store.

classes.name: DigitalProductDao
classes.description: Data Access Object interface for DigitalProduct entities, providing methods to access digital product data.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a DigitalProduct associated with a specific Product and MerchantStore.
